mentions.name: inslib
mentions.description: An open source inertial navigation library written in embedded C and Python, developed from the author's PhD thesis algorithms, with benchmarks claiming to beat ArduPilot's navigation subsystem.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been working on my inertial navigation library. It actually beats ArduPilot’s navigation subsystem in my benchmarks. I’ve been working on these algorithms since my PhD thesis and now I am releasing the stuff as open source embedded C and Python library:

https://github.com/jnz/inslib
mentions.author: janosch9001
